text:
Aisha: Heads-up — Velox Systems wants a joint perf validation for their new VLS-2 cards next week. Goal: perf/W + p95 latency at 1024 tokens under sustained load. Can we run a lean interop validation and produce a marketplace-validated number?
Tom: I can own orchestration. Do we have the target workload, datasets, and which kernel flags to test?
Priya: Velox sent two configs: `--kv-cache=on --matmul-algo=tiled128` and a quantized path `q8_0`. Recommend: cold-start, then a sustained 30min run per config.
Mateo: Add p95/p99 latencies and tail-jitter histograms. Capture trace_id, model_version, kernel_tag in every span so partner can map traces. We'll push telemetry to a shared bucket.
Aisha: @velox-ci-bot can you provision the run job + artifact bucket?
velox-ci-bot: Created job `velox/interop/1799999999`. Artifacts: `s3://redwood-velox/interop/1799999999`. ETA start: 2026-04-02 09:00 PT.
Tom: I'll drop a smoke script. Example: ```bash
./run_load_test --concurrency 128 --seq_len 1024 --duration 1800 --flags "--kv-cache=on --matmul-algo=tiled128"
```
Priya: We'll also capture powerdraw from host PDUs and `nvidia-smi` (or vendor tool) every 10s, plus CPU/GPU perf counter snapshots at start/stop.
Mateo: Let's compare `matmul=128` vs `matmul=64` and include per-config cost estimates (tokens/sec per watt). That will feed the marketplace unit-economics blurb.
VeloxOps: Thanks — we'll provide thermal headroom logs and the internal kernel patch id. Can you use the non-prod marketplace SKU `velox-vls2-interop` for the report artifacts?
Aisha: Yes. After the run we'll produce a one-page joint writeup and an artifact bundle for the marketplace listing. Scheduling a 30-min sync to align tomorrow 10:00am PT.
Tom: :thumbsup: Ping me if Velox needs SSH to the lab nodes or additional service accounts.
Priya: Quick note — do NOT enable `async_kv_prefetch` in this validation; it caused jitter in the last sweep. Keep it off for parity with earlier numbers.
Aisha: Got it. Last item: who drafts the marketplace blurb? I can take first pass and send to Velox for review.
VeloxOps: We'll review copy and supply logo + screenshots. Good to go on our side.
